================================================================================

Janua includes modified versions of the following files from
Apache Guacamole guacamole-server version 1.6.0:

1. src/protocols/rdp/gdi.c
   Modification: Added RDPGFX surface update synchronization for H.264 streams

2. src/protocols/rdp/settings.c
   Modification: Enabled H.264/AVC420 codec support for Graphics Pipeline

3. src/protocols/rdp/channels/rdpsnd/rdpsnd-messages.c
   Modification: Updated RDPSND protocol version to 8 for modern RDP servers

These modifications are Copyright (c) 2025 Skylark Software LLC,
released under GPL-3.0-only as part of the Janua project.
